budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Runners recover cipher and carry it to exact exit tile; wardens seek both runners restrained first. Extraction pays each runner +1 and each warden -1; both-captured reverses rewards. Unresolved horizon pays zero.
task.natural_termination: Extraction or both runners captured after rescue resolution ends naturally. Otherwise horizon 96, with natural priority. Terminal calls absorb preserving state and returning zero reward.
task.interaction: Opposed gate control, shared batteries, cipher dropping on tag, adjacent partner rescue, disclosed sensing relays, cloaks and scanners alter route feasibility, information and future interception.
task.observation_access: Public static map, exit, active devices/flares, clock and extraction status. Manhattan sensors through walls: courier radius 2, others 3. Friendly flares relay radius-three agent sensing and expose emitter to opponents. Cloaks hide nearby runners beyond adjacency; live flare or scanner overrides. Wardens share scanner radius 4. Carried cipher follows carrier visibility; grounded cipher, gates and caches use direct local range. Own-team energy only. Scene events exclude private capture and remote gate changes.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
